units.source_text: 发长彦从黑狗背上下来后，恭敬的给两位武士鞠了一躬，

en.t: After Haganahiko got down from the black dog's back, he respectfully bowed to the two warriors,

units.source_text: 说道：“我与两位武士达人分别后，

en.t: and said, "After I parted from you two master warriors,

units.source_text: 便赶去生驹山和笠置山，将两位公主救回来了。”

en.t: I hurried to Mount Ikoma and Mount Kasagi, and rescued the two princesses and brought them back."
